purpose: Base-color terrain textures. Height remains procedural and is not inferred from image brightness.

prompts.grass: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless PBR base-color texture for a Three.js mountain terrain, single square image 1024 x 1024. Create a photorealistic overhead orthographic scan of dense low alpine grass and tiny ground-cover vegetation, representing a 4 meter square patch. Fine irregular individual blades, mossy low foliage, a little dry grass, subtle glimpses of dark soil. Muted natural olive and sage greens, neither neon nor yellow. Rich organic microdetail throughout, natural irregularity at several sizes without isolated big clumps, evenly distributed texture density. Flat neutral diffuse illumination as an albedo scan: no baked directional shadows, highlights, ambient-occlusion black holes, center lighting, gradients or vignettes. Perfectly seamless and tileable horizontally and vertically, matching shapes and color across opposite borders. Edge-to-edge material only, no perspective, horizon, objects, flowers, text, borders, grid or watermark. Avoid obvious repeating motifs, radial composition, stripes, checkerboards or large distinctive stones. Output ONLY the single square grass texture.
prompts.dirt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless PBR base-color texture for a Three.js mountain terrain, single square image 1024 x 1024. Create a photorealistic overhead orthographic scanned surface of natural alpine mineral soil representing a 3 meter square patch. Warm neutral medium brown earth with fine mineral grains, many tiny irregular embedded stones and sand, a few subtle organic fibers. Natural multiscale irregularity, mostly fine textured earth, slightly varied compacted and loose areas, evenly distributed density, no distinctive big objects. Flat neutral diffuse illumination as a pure albedo scan: no directional shadows, no specular highlights, no vignetting or lighting gradient, no dark cracks masquerading as shading. Perfectly seamless and tileable in both axes with opposite edges matching. Edge-to-edge material, no perspective, horizon, grid, labels, borders or watermark. Avoid repetitive cracked clay polygons, cobblestones, tracks, stripes, conspicuous pebbles or isolated patches. Output ONLY the single square soil texture.
prompts.rock: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless PBR base-color texture for a Three.js mountain terrain, single square image 1024 x 1024. Create a photorealistic orthographic material scan of weathered exposed alpine granite bedrock representing a 12 meter square patch. Neutral grey with subtle warm beige and cool mineral variation, fine crystalline grain, irregular fractured rock planes and occasional thin mineral veins, sparse natural cracks at different sizes. Geological organic structure, no evenly sized pieces. Flat diffuse illumination as a PBR albedo scan with minimal baked shadows or occlusion, no directional light, no specular highlights, vignetting or brightness gradient. Perfectly seamless and tileable horizontally and vertically, matching shapes and tones at opposite edges. Edge-to-edge rock surface only, no perspective, horizon, separate rocks on ground, plants, snow, text, border or watermark. Avoid regular polygon networks, cobblestone paving, bricks, fish scales, repeated holes, dramatic big black cracks, central focal features or repeated bands. Output ONLY the single square rock texture.
